pricePolicy: Fictional EUR minor units: max(100, floor((observed MDL × 5) / 50 + 0.5) × 50). This is demo price design, not currency conversion or current restaurant pricing.
allergenPolicy: Conservative ingredient-based hints only; no complete ingredient or cross-contact verification. Empty lists do not establish absence. No vegetarian, vegan or other dietary claims are assigned to these selected items.
imagePolicy: Only original illustrative category photographs from TableKind assets. Shared category images do not depict each exact recipe or portion. No source photography is downloaded or embedded.
